we provide the first rigorous analysis of a constant learning rate algorithm with a square root of the number of samples regret in the online streaming setting, we show that a constant learning rate can be replaced by an adaptive learning rate, we extend the result to the standard online learning setting, and we provide a new analysis of a two layer neural net with ReLU activation

we introduce regret with rolling windows and propose a family of online algorithms with constant and adaptive learning rate.
